authority.user_instruction: Execute the approved BurnLens Experiment Four long-running goal in https://github.com/drwbkr1/burnlens-experiment-four.

scope.objective: Determine whether the frozen six-pilot plus 30-final-event design is feasible from a complete, replayable metadata-defined universe before opening scientific source bodies.
forbidden_work: Open, download, copy, or inspect scientific source bodies, imagery pixels, reference rasters, labels, or model artifacts before an exact source gate
Adopt an external source, dependency, runtime, service, credential, account, terms change, or paid resource without the declared gate
Select final events or pilot events, draw AOIs, construct labels, train, infer, evaluate, or render scientific outputs
Use any model output, burn index, prediction, metric, error surface, or scene-body observation to determine eligibility or exclusion
Relax the six-pilot plus 30-final-event requirement, substitute prior-experiment events, or conceal missing and conflicting identities
Create a scientific tag, release, deployment, model claim, dataset claim, or operational wildfire claim
reversible_actions: Read public project records and Git history without modifying prior repositories
Create public-safe metadata schemas, source proposals, inventories, manifests, scripts, tests, and aggregate receipts
Perform anonymous metadata discovery without accessing scientific source bodies
Measure storage, compute, and review capacity using estimates and synthetic fixtures
Repair agent-owned structural defects and manage the issue-backed milestone branch and pull request
stop_conditions: A source, dependency, runtime, service, credential, rights, terms, spending, or account decision is required
A prior-event identity is ambiguous or cannot be reconciled without scientific source-body access
A candidate-universe rule would use model output or require a frozen-design change
Fewer than six pilot plus 30 final slots can qualify without relaxing requirements
An action falls outside the authorized action classes

units.purpose: Activate exact metadata-only authority, profile, issue, branch, and contract from the accepted Milestone 0 checkpoint.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The bounded metadata-only contract enables the first evidence unit without admitting a source.

units.purpose: Build a complete identity-bound exclusion inventory for every event used by Experiments One through Three from read-only public project records.
inputs: Read-only canonical repositories and public release records for Experiments One through Three
outputs: Bounded identity gaps and conservative matching policy in the manifest

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Fresh-event eligibility cannot be evaluated until all prior experiment identities are excluded.

units.purpose: Freeze the candidate-universe metadata schema, deterministic eligibility fields, reason codes, identity rules, and replay contract without enumerating candidates.
retained_failures: Attempt 1: Milestone 0 top-level allowlist omitted Milestone 1 schemas and src paths; narrow repair passed

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The universe must be defined before source rows are observed.

units.purpose: Prepare and obtain an exact owner decision on official metadata sources, revisions, terms, rights, access, attribution, and downstream use before adoption.
inputs: Official publisher documentation and metadata-only probes
retained_failures: Attempt 1: source-review validation used literal wording and any checked token instead of testing accepted semantic boundary phrases and the actual radio checked attribute; the validator was narrowly repaired and passed

exit_condition_delta.rationale: No external metadata source becomes authoritative through inspection alone.

units.purpose: Enumerate and account for the complete metadata-defined candidate universe under the frozen schema and admitted exact sources.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Feasibility must use the complete predeclared universe rather than convenient examples.

units.purpose: Verify metadata-level imagery/reference availability and bounded storage, compute, and independent-review capacity for six pilots plus 30 final events.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: A metadata-rich universe is insufficient if the frozen study cannot be acquired and reviewed.

units.purpose: Independently validate identities, completeness, exclusion logic, replay, leakage controls, and capacity before assigning the terminal Milestone 1 disposition.
outputs: PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, or INVALID disposition

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Milestone 2 is allowed only if the frozen design is genuinely feasible.

required_checks: exact source gate and owner decision
complete diff and live publication verification

handoff.current_checkpoint: Milestone 0 accepted; Milestone 1 source review bundle 7423219b7d23388546fb7d1db0d66e83ade8958fe20ee97fc19ab95952ba62f7 is prepared with zero source adoptions and zero candidate rows.
handoff.next_action: Present the exact M1-U004 bundle and wait for the owner decision; lock and reconcile only an exact returned response.
do_not_carry_forward: Any assumption that a prior event name is a complete event identity
Any source authority inferred from anonymous discovery
Any prior dataset, label, model output, threshold, metric, or scientific disposition
Any authority to open source bodies, adopt a source, select events, train, evaluate, or release
